title: 信頼性工学
subtitle: Reliability Engineering
keywords: Statistical data 2.Quantity for reliability 3.Reliability of structures 4.Reliability of systems
educationalGoal: To minimize the risk of aircraft accidents, it is important to eliminate defects in electronic control systems or structural systems. In this course students will learn: (1) the basic mathematics used in reliability engineering, (2) the concept of structural reliability design, (3) reliability analysis and reliability design methods for aircraft equipment systems
advice: After learning the basic mathematics used in reliability engineering (basics of probability and statistics), students will learn the concept of structural reliability design of aircraft. Students will also learn about reliability analysis and reliability design methods for aircraft equipment systems. In this course, we will cover the following materials: 1. Reliability and reliability engineering 2. The basic The basic mathematics used in reliability engineering 3. Statistical analysis of reliability data 4. Reliability for structural systems 5. Reliability for electronic control systems
books: Required materials will be specified in the first lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of probability and statistics Basic knowledge of calculus, including differentiation and integration

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain the importance of reliability engineering in aircraft systems
Be able to explain basic quantities of system reliability
Be able to calculate the reliability of parallel, series and bridge systems
Be able to determine the design allowable stress of metallic materials from tensile strength test data

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand and explain the importance of reliability engineering in aircraft systems (2) Explain basic quantities of system reliability (reliability, probability density function of failure time, instantaneous failure rate) and the relationships between them. (3) Calculate the reliability of the parallel, series and bridge systems. (4) Determine the design allowable stress of metallic materials used in aircraft from tensile strength test data. Explain the concept of the reliability of aircraft structures.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the importance of reliability engineering in aircraft systems (2) Explain basic quantities of system reliability (reliability, probability density function of failure time, instantaneous failure rate). (3) Calculate the reliability of the parallel and series systems. (4) Explain the design allowable stress of metallic materials used in aircraft
